parameters.query:
-- Register (or re-home) this phone for the caller. A user still mid-setup
-- has no company: nothing to push yet, so no row is written.
-- ON CONFLICT re-homes the token when the same phone signs in as someone else.
WITH me AS (
  SELECT id, company_id FROM users WHERE id = NULLIF(btrim($1::text), '')::uuid
)
INSERT INTO device_tokens (token, platform, device_name, user_id, company_id)
SELECT btrim($2::text),
       COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim($3::text), ''), 'android'),
       NULLIF(btrim($4::text), ''),
       me.id,
       me.company_id
  FROM me
 WHERE me.company_id IS NOT NULL
ON CONFLICT (token) DO UPDATE SET
    platform     = EXCLUDED.platform,
    device_name  = EXCLUDED.device_name,
    user_id      = EXCLUDED.user_id,
    company_id   = EXCLUDED.company_id,
    last_seen_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
RETURNING company_id;

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { status: 'unauthorized', ok: false, registered: false, error: 'AUTH_REQUIRED' } }}
